description: Re-key the dead developer_scorecards table from (project_id, actor) to the component: add component_id + evaluated_at, index (component_id, evaluated_at), and relax project_id/overall_score/letter_grade NOT NULL so a component-keyed and an unassessed row are both representable (idp-score-01-d1).
reversible_note: down.py drops the added columns and index; the NOT NULL relaxation is forward-only because restoring it would raise on the component-keyed rows the migration exists to permit.
